paragraphs: The XK 4.2 V8 uses the AJ-V8 Gen III — a 4.2-litre naturally aspirated V8 petrol engine. It was fitted from 2005 to 2014 across the X150 generation of the XK, replacing the earlier X100-era AJ26/AJ27 engines. The AJ-V8 Gen III represents a significant evolution of Jaguar's V8 family, with improved timing chain components and revised cylinder heads compared to earlier iterations. The XK 4.2 V8 is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road. Jaguar XK 4.2 V8 Engine Compatibility The XK 4.2 V8 uses the AJ-V8 Gen III engine across its entire X150 production run. Unlike some models that switched engines mid-generation, the 4.2-litre V8 remained consistent throughout. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the XK 4.2 V8 from 2023 to present. The AJ-V8 Gen III features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older AJ-V8 Gen III V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every AJ-V8 Gen III rebuild.
